body:
Bring the Tauri desktop app under Solace, so its build can be a recipe. Today `solace-app` isn't in the root `solace.toml` `projects` list, so agents can't change it through a task scope.

- Give `solace-app` its own `solace.toml`. Its `unwatched` covers `target/`, `binaries/` and `gen/`.
- Adding `solace-app` to the root `projects` list goes to the human as a settings proposal (D-38).
- Check that it works as a plain-files/Rust project: `files --project solace-app`, reads and grep, and a lane on the board.
- Update the root README's project list.

No build changes here. The next task moves its build into a recipe.
title: self-build: solace-app as a project
